title: AEFSO — abstract execution formalism as optional representation layer
summary: AEFSO (All Elementary Functions from a Single Operator) is more likely a representation-layer or symbolic-search primitive than a direct replacement for core physics models. Accepted as an optional backend representation layer within explicit scope bounds. Core promotion is blocked.
findings: AEFSO converges to design-update insight: optional backend representation layer
Accepted as symbolic-search primitive within bounded scope
Rejected for core promotion; next gate is closed
Review path: scope and claim-honesty review, fhval validation, internal testing
